summary: Iter 56 — Admin 'test mode' toggle for users.email_verified. Backend endpoint PUT /api/admin/users/{user_id}/email-verified verified end-to-end (5 new pytest cases, all PASS). All 9 prior email-verification regression tests still PASS (14/14 total). Frontend regression: /verify-email?status=success renders correctly; /admin/login renders correctly (admin TOTP flow is friction-by-design — per E1 note, backend curl path is the accepted route, and the new data-testids 'admin-email-verified-card' + 'admin-action-toggle-email-verified' are confirmed present at AdminPages.jsx lines 282 and 301).
critical_code_review_comments: admin_routes.py admin_toggle_email_verified() does in-function 'from datetime import ...' shadow — datetime/timezone are already imported at module top; the local re-import is dead-but-harmless. Consider removing for cleanliness.

Audit row uses field 'at' for the timestamp but the user_detail() endpoint sorts other audit rows by 'ts' (db.audit_events vs. db.admin_audit are two different collections — admin_audit is the canonical admin trail). The new code writes to db.audit_events with key 'at' and actor_id/actor_email; user_detail() reads db.audit_events sorted by 'ts'. So the new audit rows WILL render in the user-detail audit list but will sort *to the bottom* (missing 'ts' field). Recommend either (a) also write 'ts' for consistency, OR (b) write to db.admin_audit via the existing audit_log() helper which already exists in admin_auth.py.

Endpoint shadows the module-level `admin` APIRouter symbol with the `admin: dict = Depends(...)` parameter name. Works fine, but is confusing on read — pattern used by adjacent toggle_admin() too, so a wider rename pass is warranted.
